programs.title: Phantom Signals
programs.desc: Surrounded by an invisible sphere of infinite data, the understanding of the universe depends on signals that are sent and received; once in a while, a strange phenomenon occurs, such as a faulty message or a literal blip on a screen.

programs.title: Ancient Bodies: Secrets Revealed
programs.desc: A German village is shocked when a body is found mutilated beyond recognition; when archaeologists investigate further, they find evidence of human sacrifice.

programs.title: Alien Corridors
programs.desc: With more than 300 UFO sightings each year, the townspeople living within the Falkirk Triangle can't help but feel uneasy about the strange occurrences. From reports of abduction, missing persons, lost time and physical attack, to unexplained interference on airport radar. What evidence exists that the first sighting took place as early as 1767? And why has the local provost continued to lobby three prime ministers to investigate to no avail?

programs.title: Secrets in the Ice
programs.desc: A volcanic island off the coast of Antarctica with a mysterious past; the mummified remains of a teenage girl in the Peruvian Andes; a shipwreck is found near Russia's Franz Josef Archipelago; strange holes appearing in snow in Japan.

programs.title: Mysteries of the Ancient Dead
programs.desc: In 1928, an earthquake shift uncovers a row of painted warriors -- seven-foot statues encasing mummies from an ancient civilization; curious bone arrangements in Winterborne are somehow linked to intermingled ashes from dig sites of Slovenia.

programs.title: How I Got Here
programs.desc: Aleksander returns to Serbia for the first time in almost 30 years, traveling with his son, Sebastian, to discover the places and people left behind during the Kosovo War; Sebastian searches for a better understanding of his heritage and his father.

programs.title: Quest for the Lost Vikings
programs.desc: The expedition takes the Fara Heim team near Bloodvein, Manitoba where a large boulder may hold a great mystery of a lost Viking expedition. Meanwhile, Jo tries his hand at metal detecting near a historic fur trading fort.

programs.title: How I Got Here
programs.desc: Michael and his father, John, travel to Italy together for the first time; despite their sometimes rocky relationship, the two work together to explore the culture that has shaped each of them and may help them reconnect for good.

programs.title: Fishing for History
programs.desc: The boys head out to the UNESCO World Heritage Site of the Rideau Canal and explore the waters around one of the last hand-operated locks in North America.

programs.title: Fishing for History
programs.desc: The banks of the Thames River in Ontario were the site of the battle won by Americans at Moraviantown during the War of 1812; after more than 11,000 years of human settlement, these banks may have more than just secrets.

programs.title: Mapping Disaster
programs.desc: A journey through some of the most catastrophic events in human history, exploring disasters that can impact and change communities, and gaining new insight into how to design and construct communities to meet the dangers of the future.

programs.title: Pharaohs: Rise & Fall
programs.desc: Egypt is divided; local rulers called nomarchs vie for power, but only one will rise up to restore the kingdom and usher in a new era for the pharaohs; using literature, military might and conquest, the pharaoh and his forebears regain power.
